subject: Sinking Lure
text: The Sinking Lure becomes available in the Fishing Hole after catching a fish weighing at least 15 lbs.

evidence.quote: After catching a fish of at least 15 lbs. in the Fishing Hole, the Sinking Lure will be available.

subject: Sinking Lure
text: To make the Sinking Lure legal, talk to the Fishing Hole owner while holding it.

evidence.quote: TO MAKE THE SINKING LURE LEGAL: Grab it, and go over to the owner. Say that you want to talk to him and he'll make the Sinking Lure legal.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: The rare Hylian Loach appears randomly in the Fishing Hole, weighing 18 pounds as Young Link or 35 pounds as Adult Link.

evidence.quote: The Hylian Loach is a very rare fish that randomly appears in the Fishing Hole. It weighs 18 pounds as Young Link or 35 pounds as Adult Link.

subject: Fisherman's Hat
text: As Adult Link, casting your line at the fisherman's head can snatch his hat, and casting it into the pond incurs a 50 Rupees fine.

evidence.quote: When you visit the Fishing Hole as Adult Link, the fisherman owning the place now wears a hat. If you cast JUST right, you can snare the hat right off of his head. ... Of course, you can be mean and cast his hat into the pond, but he'll fine you 50 Rupees.

subject: Kokiri Forest Secret Cave Chest
text: Playing the Song of Storms near the Gossip Stone near the Lost Woods entrance reveals a Secret Cave with a treasure chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: Head near the entrance of Lost Woods to find a Gossip Stone. Play the Song of Storms near it to reveal the Secret Cave. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone and a treasure chest with a Red Rupee inside.

subject: Lost Woods Business Deku Scrub
text: Bombing the rock outside the Sacred Forest Meadow entrance reveals a cave with Business Deku Scrubs selling Deku Seeds and a Deku Nut Upgrade.

evidence.quote: After exiting the Sacred Forest Meadow, bomb the rock you find there. CONTENTS: Two Business Deku Scrubs.  One sells a Deku Nut Upgrade and one sells Deku Seeds.

subject: Lost Woods Secret Cave Chest
text: Blasting the boulder found by turning right and left from the Kokiri Forest entrance reveals a Secret Cave with a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Enter Lost Woods via Kokiri Forest, turn right, left, and blast the boulder with a bomb. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone, and small chest containing a Blue Rupee

subject: The Forest Stage
text: Following the path right, left, right, left, and left from the Kokiri Forest entrance leads Child Link to the Forest Stage cave hidden in the grass.

evidence.quote: Enter Lost Woods via Kokiri Forest, turn right, left, right, left and left again. ... You must be a child in order to do this, though. CONTENTS: The Forest Stage.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Bombing the foot of the tree near the castle walls past the bridge toward Kakariko Village reveals a hole containing a Gold Skulltula behind cobwebs.

evidence.quote: Face the entrance to Hyrule Castle, then start heading towards the entrance to Kakariko Village. Stop when you get past the little bridge and head to the tree near the castle walls. Plant a bomb at the foot of the tree to reveal the hole. CONTENTS: A Skulltula and Gold Skulltula behind cobwebs.

subject: Hyrule Field Secret Cave Chest
text: Blasting the boulder along the wall to the left of the Hyrule Castle entrance reveals a Secret Cave with a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: There's some trees here and a boulder. Blast open the boulder to reveal a Secret Cave. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone, small chest containing Blue Rupee.

subject: Hyrule Field Secret Cave
text: Bombing the foot of the lone tree near the river left of the castle entrance reveals a Secret Cave with a Piece of Heart in a pool of water.

evidence.quote: Keep going left from the previous secret to find a bunch of trees and a river. Plant a bomb at the foot of the lone tree to reveal yet another Secret Cave. CONTENTS: A pool of water with a Piece of Heart down below, and a Blue Tektite.

subject: Hyrule Field Fairy Fountain
text: Breaking the boulder on the other side of the river across from the lone tree reveals a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: Go to the other side of the river and blast/break the boulder to reveal this one. CONTENTS: A Fairy Fountain

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Bombing the center of a circle of stones near the Gerudo Valley entrance reveals a Secret Cave with a Gold Skulltula and a cow behind cobwebs.

evidence.quote: A little right from the entrance to Gerudo Valley, on the same cliff, is a big boulder surrounded by a circle of little stones. Break the boulder first, then plant a bomb in the center of the circle of stones to reveal this Secret Cave. CONTENTS: A Gossip Stone, Skulltula, cow, and Gold Skulltula all behind cobwebs.

subject: Lake Hylia Business Scrub
text: Bombing the center of the square of fences in front of the Lake Hylia entrance reveals a Secret Cave with a Business Scrub selling a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: In front of the entrance to Hylia Lake is a square of fences. Plant a bomb right in the center to reveal another Secret Cave. CONTENTS: Business Scrub that sells you a Piece of Heart.

subject: Lake Hylia Entrance Secret Cave Chest
text: An open hole near the fence square by the Lake Hylia entrance contains a small chest with a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: There's a hole out in the open near the above Secret Cave waiting to be found. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone and a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

subject: Hyrule Field Mini-Forest Secret Cave Chest
text: Breaking the boulder among the trees in Hyrule Field's mini-forest reveals a Secret Cave with a small chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: There's a mini-forest in Hyrule Field. Among the trees is a boulder. Break it to reveal the last Secret Cave here. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone and a small chest containing a Red Rupee.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Playing the Song of Storms near the tree inside the Castle Fence opens a cave with three bombable walls concealing a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Storms near the tree that's inside the Castle Fence. CONTENTS: Prepare for a long list. There's three bombable walls. Behind one of them are bugs, three pots, eight stones, and a Gossip Stone. Behind another one is a Skullwalltula, and the final one has a Skullwalltula and Gold Skulltula.

subject: Kakariko Village Well Path Secret Cave Chest
text: Bombing between the tree and stairs to the well reveals a Secret Cave where defeating two Redeads awards a small chest with a Huge Rupee.

evidence.quote: Between the tree and the stairs to the well is where the Secret Cave is. Plant a bomb somewhere between those things. CONTENTS: Two Redeads. Kill them to reveal a small chest with a Huge Rupee inside.

subject: Kakariko Village Potion Shop Secret Cave Chest
text: Dropping into the hole near the Potion Shop reveals a Secret Cave with a treasure chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: There's a hole on the ground near the Potion Shop. Just drop right in. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone, a fish, and a treasure chest with a Red Rupee inside.

subject: Graveyard Secret Grave Chest
text: Pushing gravestones in the Graveyard reveals a hole containing a chest with a Hylian Shield and another containing a Redead and a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: All the secrets here are found by pushing the gravestones. CONTENTS: One hole has a Redead and a Piece of Heart (using Sun's Song) and one has a chest with a Hylian Shield.

subject: Death Mountain Trail Secret Cave Chest
text: Playing the Song of Storms inside the rock circle near the Goron City entrance reveals a hole with a chest containing a Huge Rupee.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Storms in the middle of the circle of rocks on the platform to reveal the hole. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone and treasure chest containing a Huge Rupee

subject: Death Mountain Trail Summit Platform Secret Cave
text: Blasting the rock on the platform near the danger sign on the path to the summit reveals a Secret Cave with a cow, Recovery Hearts, and Green Rupees.

evidence.quote: At the place where you jump platforms to reach the summit, there's a rock on one of the platforms. Blast or break it to reveal a Secret Cave. ... CONTENTS: Green Rupees, Recovery Hearts, and a cow

subject: Death Mountain Crater Business Scrubs
text: Breaking the boulder near the Fire Temple entrance with the Megaton Hammer reveals three Business Scrubs selling bombs, Deku Nuts, and Arrows.

evidence.quote: Nearby the entrance to the Fire Temple, there's a boulder that can be broken with the Megaton Hammer. Do so to reveal the secret. CONTENTS: Three Business Scrubs. One sells bombs, one sells Deku Nuts, one sells Arrows.

subject: Death Mountain Crater Entrance Secret Cave Chest
text: Blasting the boulder inside the circle of stones near the main entrance reveals a small chest containing Bombs.

evidence.quote: Just inside from the main entrance is a circle of stones with a boulder in the center. Blast the boulder to reveal the secret. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone and a small chest containing Bombs

subject: Goron City Lava Room Secret Cave Chest
text: Playing the Song of Storms in the lava room as Child Link and returning as Adult Link with the Longshot accesses a chest containing a Huge Rupee.

evidence.quote: go to the lava room as Child Link. Play the Song of Storms here, then leave. Come back as Adult Link and you'll be able to use your Longshot to get to the other side where the hole is. CONTENTS: Gossip Stone and treasure chest containing a Huge Rupee

subject: Zora's River Business Scrubs
text: Playing the Song of Storms in the rock circle near the river entrance reveals Business Scrubs selling Green Potions and Red Potions for 40 Rupees a bottle each.

evidence.quote: Near the entrance to the River, in the corner where a Cucco is, is a circle of rocks. Play the Song of Storms near it to reveal this Secret Cave. CONTENTS: Two Business Scrubs. One sells Green Potions for 40 Rupees a bottle, and the other sells Red Potions for the same price each bottle.

subject: Zora's River Magic Bean Platform Open Cave Chest
text: Riding the Magic Bean plant as Adult Link reaches an elevated platform with an open cave holding a chest with a Red Rupee and a boulder concealing a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: Plant a Magic Bean in the sandy patch here near the beginning, then ride it (as Adult Link) to head to a platform with two Secret Caves. ... CONTENTS: The one out in the open has a Gossip Stone and a small chest with a Red Rupee, and the one under the boulder has a Fairy Fountain.

subject: Zora's Domain Fairy Fountain
text: Playing the Song of Storms on the flat unsubmerged rock in Zora's Domain reveals a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Storms on the flat, unsubmerged rock. CONTENTS: A Fairy Fountain

subject: Lake Hylia Island Secret Grave
text: Pushing the grave on one of the Lake Hylia islands reveals a Secret Cave with three Business Scrubs selling general pick-up items.

evidence.quote: One of the islands here has a grave that can be pushed to reveal this Secret Cave. CONTENTS: Three Business Scrubs which sell general pick-up items.

subject: Gerudo Valley Business Scrubs
text: Playing the Song of Storms behind the carpenter's tent reveals Business Scrubs selling Green Potions and Red Potions for 40 Rupees a bottle each.

evidence.quote: Playing the Song of Storms whilst behind the carpenter's tent will reveal this little secret. CONTENTS: Two Business Scrubs. One sells Green Potions for 40 Rupees a bottle, and the other sells Red Potions for the same price each bottle.

subject: Gerudo Valley Canyon Ledge Secret Cave
text: Lifting the white stone boulder on the canyon ledge with the Silver Gauntlets reveals a pool of water with Rupees guarded by an Octorok.

evidence.quote: Make sure you have at least the Silver Gauntlets before attempting this one. Stand near the canyon and look down, and you should see a small ledge with a white stone. Jump down and pick up the boulder to reveal the secret. CONTENTS: A pool of water with a ton of Rupees.  An Octorok guards this loot.

subject: Gerudo Fortress Fairy Fountain
text: Playing the Song of Storms near the four boxes at the Gerudo Fortress main entrance reveals a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: At the fortress's main entrance are four boxes. Play the Song of Storms near them to reveal this secret. ... CONTENTS: A Fairy Fountain

subject: Sacred Forest Meadow Secret Shrine Chest
text: Bombing near the Lost Woods entrance across from the Forest Temple reveals a shrine where defeating two Wolfos reveals a small chest with a purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: Place a bomb near the entrance to Lost Woods at the other side of the Forest Temple. CONTENTS: A strange shrine with two guardian Wolfos. Kill them both to reveal a small chest containing a purple Rupee.

subject: Sacred Forest Meadow Fairy Fountain
text: A hole on the ground in the middle of the maze leading to the Forest Temple contains a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: There's a hole on the ground in the middle of the maze to the Forest Temple. CONTENTS: A Fairy Fountain

subject: Desert Colossus Business Scrubs
text: Lifting the boulder near the Spirit Temple entrance using the Silver Gauntlets reveals Business Scrubs selling Green Potions and Red Potions for 40 Rupees a bottle each.

evidence.quote: There's a boulder that can be lifted near the entrance to the Spirit Temple. Must have at least the Silver Gauntlets. CONTENTS: Two Business Scrubs. One sells Green Potions for 40 Rupees a bottle, and the other sells Red Potions for the same price each bottle.

subject: Amy
text: Amy is one of the Poe sisters in the Forest Temple who must be fought after moving blocks to assemble a picture of her.

evidence.quote: Amy...Description: One of the Poe sisters in the Forest Temple. Aim for her when she appears. Before fighting her, you have to move blocks to form a picture of her.

subject: Anubis
text: Anubis mirrors the player's movements and is vulnerable to fire traps or fire attacks.

evidence.quote: Anubis...Description: Vulnerable to fire, this enemy moves as you move, acting like a mirrored version of yourself. It occasionally fires bursts of fire if you take too long to lure it into the fire trap.

subject: Armos
text: Armos awakens when touched and can only be defeated with a bomb, hopping toward Link before exploding.

evidence.quote: Armos...Description: A live statue which awakes when you touch it. The only way to kill it is with a bomb. After getting hit by one, it hops toward you to try to take you down with it.

subject: Baby Dodongo
text: Baby Dodongo blows up when struck anywhere and can serve as a substitute bomb against bombable objects.

evidence.quote: Baby Dodongo...Description: Obviously a smaller version of the Dodongo. Striking it anywhere will kill it, and it'll blow up. They can be used as bomb substitutes if they are lured to something bombable before you kill them.

subject: Bari
text: Bari is a larger version of Biri equipped with elongated stingers.

evidence.quote: Bari...Description: A larger version of the Biri. Careful of its elongated stingers!

subject: Beamos
text: Beamos fires a continuous beam when it detects Link and can only be destroyed with bombs.

evidence.quote: Beamos...Description: Whenever it spots you, it fires a continuous beam until you get hit or get out of its range. The only way to defeat these is to bomb them to death.

subject: Beth
text: Beth is one of the Poe sisters encountered in the Forest Temple.

evidence.quote: Beth...Description: One of the Poe sisters in the Forest Temple. Aim for her when she appears!

subject: Big Deku Baba
text: Big Deku Baba is a larger version of the Fierce Deku Baba found in Kokiri Forest when playing as Adult Link.

evidence.quote: Big Deku Baba...Description: Found in Kokiri Forest as Adult Link, these are simply a much larger version of the Fierce Deku Baba that infested the Deku Tree's innards.

subject: Bigocto
text: Bigocto is the sub-boss of Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly, defeated by stunning it with the Boomerang and slashing its exposed green backside.

evidence.quote: Bigocto: MINI-BOSS OF INSIDE JABU-JABU'S BELLY...Description: A giant Octorok who's weak point is its backside. Stun it with the Boomerang and it'll open its green backside. Slash the green section to harm it. This is the sub-boss for the Jabu-Jabu's Belly dungeon.

subject: Big Poe
text: Capturing all 10 Big Poes on horseback in Hyrule Field and bringing them to the Poe salesman in ruined Market yields an Empty Bottle.

evidence.quote: Big Poe...Description: A larger and rarer Poe. They appear in Hyrule Field and attempt to chase away from you. You can't catch them unless you have Epona and the Fairy Bow with you. There are 10 in all, and if you capture them all in bottles and give them to the Poe salesman in the destroyed Hyrule Town, you'll get an Empty Bottle.

subject: Big Skulltula
text: Big Skulltula hangs from webs and is vulnerable to strikes on its soft belly when it turns to expose it.

evidence.quote: Big Skulltula...Description: These hang from webs and come down to strike when you're near. ... Their weak spot is their belly: when they show it, strike there to kill them.
